nom: Clarins Beauty Flash Balm Mask, Primer, Radiance Booster

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin and rosacea report the balm is lightweight, does not cause breakouts, and does not aggravate rosacea, though one sensitive reviewer reports burning/irritation on application.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe themselves as mature (50s-70s) report a long-standing routine with the product, citing a smoothing, firming, glow effect and softened fine lines, though several say the reformulated version no longer delivers the same tightening.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer with pores that congest quickly reports the product smooths the skin surface and gives a deep-clean, fresh glow.
segments.dry: A reviewer in a very dry climate reports the balm keeps her face moisturized all day.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother, firmer-looking skin and reduced appearance of fine lines; one reviewer says it did not eliminate her fine lines but gave a slight blurring effect, and another says the tightening was weaker than expected.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the product moisturizes well and keeps skin hydrated all day, including one in a very dry climate; one reviewer using the new formula found it sticky/greasy rather than hydrating in the way the original was.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports no effect on her redness (neither worsened nor visibly improved); another reports no redness or irritation after light flaking from use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the product left her skin barrier smooth; no other barrier-specific comments are reported.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product lightened dark spots and minimized pores after first use; another hopes it will help with hyperpigmentation but had not yet seen results after two uses.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer explicitly reports no breakouts; no other reviewer discusses blemishes directly.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the moisture feels non-greasy on her skin, while another describes the reformulated version as greasy and jelly-like.

extraits.titre: TERRIBLE REFORMULATION OF A PERFECT PRODUCT
extraits.texte: Like so many others, I used the original Beauty Flash Balm for many years and absolutely loved it! It made my skin look and feel fabulous and was so silky and smooth to apply. Also loved it for a quick skin refresh at the end of my work day if I was going out. I purchased the new formula a number of months ago, and really hated it. It was so sticky on my skin, and I could not apply makeup over it for the stickiness. My skin did not feel at all smooth, plumped, or revitalized as it always had with the original formula. It also had a very odd and not pleasing fragrance. Thankfully, at the time, I found a holiday gift set that included the original formula, so I bought about 6 sets, just to have the original BFB product. I have used up all but one, so now I really don't know what to do. PLEASE, PLEASE, PLEASE BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL FORMULA - OR MAKE BOTH AVAILABLE. I am seeing as many people in these reviews who do not like the new formula as those who do, so that could be a good option. Please listen to us and bring back the original and wonderful BFB. This, to me, is a classic example of breaking something that clearly was not broken.

Clarins: I'm begging you. Make a fragrance-free version of Beauty Flash Balm. It's a fantastic product and I can't use it without being nauseated and getting a migraine. The fragrance adds nothing. People can wear perfume if they want to, but it's just not necessary in a face cream.
Does anyone elses skin burn when they use this product? I leave it on for 5 minutes and during that time it burns/irritates my skin.

My husband had a sample size in one of his international flight kits, and I really like the texture and scent so I had to order. It's very lightweight but seems to moisturize very well. I do not break out. It does not affect my rosacea. Not sure I'm getting a lot of tightening yet but we will see.

extraits.titre: Great looking skin with first try
extraits.texte: I have never used a product that gives such overall wonderful results. It addressed, smooth skin, lighten dark spots, minimize pores. This morning there was a very light flake of old skin, no redness or irritation, just a smooth and beautiful result. I have used many of Clarins product, and with some exceptions liked them all. But this one is off the charts winner.

I didn't use this kind of acids before, but I have a combination type of skin and my pores get congested pretty fast. It was time to try. This product smooths the surface of the skin, gives a nice deep cleans, and fresh look and glow on the face after use.

I live in the high desert and struggle to maintain moisture on my skin. I tried the beauty flash balm as a sample and couldn't wait to receive my full size product. Using Beauty Flash Balm my face feels moisturized all day.
